name.description: The name used for all resources in this module

file_system_type.description: The type of file system. Valid values: standard, extreme, cpfs

protocol_type.description: File transfer protocol type. Valid values: NFS, SMB, cpfs

storage_type.description: The storage type. For standard: Performance, Capacity, Premium. For extreme: standard, advance

encrypt_type.description: Whether the file system is encrypted. 0: not encrypted, 1: NAS managed key, 2: User management key

capacity.description: The capacity of the file system in GiB. Required when file_system_type = extreme

zone_id.description: The zone ID. Required when file_system_type = extreme or cpfs

kms_key_id.description: The KMS key ID for encryption. Required when encrypt_type = 2

vswitch_id.description: The ID of the VSwitch for mount target

status.description: The status of the mount target. Valid values: Active, Inactive

access_group_name.description: The name of the permission group

access_group_type.description: Permission group types. Valid values: Vpc, Classic

quota_path.description: The absolute path of the directory for quota

nas_file_system_id.description: Existing file system ID. If provided, will not create new file system
